title.en: A Tang copy of the Orchid Pavilion preface

alt.en: Columns of flowing black calligraphy on tan paper, overlaid with red collectors’ seals.
alt.zh: 褐色纸上书写流动的黑色行书，间有红色鉴藏印。

caption.en: Copy attributed to Feng Chengsu, Tang dynasty, after Wang Xizhi’s preface of 353. Palace Museum, Beijing.
caption.zh: 传冯承素唐摹王羲之353年《兰亭序》，北京故宫博物院藏。

items.creator: Attributed to Feng Chengsu, after Wang Xizhi
items.date: Tang dynasty, 7th century; text composed in 353

interpretation.en: The changing rhythm of characters and accumulated seals show both copying and collecting. This surviving sheet is a later copy, not Wang Xizhi’s autograph.
interpretation.zh: 字势节奏与累积的印章，同时呈现摹写和收藏的历史。这是后世摹本，不是王羲之亲笔原迹。

title.en: Tao Yuanming returning home, imagined in 1650
title.zh: 1650年画家笔下的陶渊明归去来

alt.en: A bearded traveler carries a crooked staff; wide sleeves and robe stream to the right between calligraphic inscriptions.
alt.zh: 蓄须行者持曲杖，宽袖衣带向右飘动，两侧有书法题字。

caption.en: Returning Home, a detail from Chen Hongshou’s Scenes from the Life of Tao Yuanming, dated 1650. Ink and color on silk, Honolulu Museum of Art, 1912.1.
caption.zh: 陈洪绶1650年《陶渊明故事图》“归去来”局部，绢本设色，檀香山艺术博物馆藏，1912.1。

items.creator: Chen Hongshou (1598–1652); photograph by Hiart

interpretation.en: Windblown robes turn withdrawal into a dramatic journey. Painted more than a millennium after Tao’s life, the scene belongs to his literary afterlife.
interpretation.zh: 飘扬的衣袍把归隐表现为富有动势的行旅。作品距陶渊明在世逾千年，属于其文学接受史。

alt.zh: 蓄须男子戴高黑帽、着红袍，胸前饰有补子。

caption.en: Anonymous seventeenth-century portrait of Xu Guangqi, credited by the source to Nanjing Museum. The source does not establish whether it was painted during his lifetime.
caption.zh: 无款十七世纪徐光启像，来源注明南京博物院藏；资料未确定是否绘于其在世时。

items.creator: Anonymous painter
items.institution: Nanjing Museum, as credited by the image source

interpretation.en: Official dress places the mathematical translator within the world of state service. The portrait’s broad dating does not establish a documented likeness from life.
interpretation.zh: 官服把数学翻译者置于国家官僚的世界中。宽泛断代不足以证明它是有据的生前写照。

title.en: Ban Zhao teaching in Famous Women

alt.en: A seated woman reads at a table while two standing figures hold stacked books.
alt.zh: 一位女子坐在案前读书，两名站立人物捧着成叠书册。

caption.en: Gai Qi’s depiction of Ban Zhao in Famous Women, 1799, an album commissioned by the poet Cao Zhenxiu. Metropolitan Museum of Art, 2016.362a–t.
caption.zh: 改琦1799年《列女图》中的班昭，由诗人曹贞秀委绘；纽约大都会艺术博物馆藏，2016.362a–t。

items.creator: Gai Qi (paintings); Cao Zhenxiu (album inscriptions)

interpretation.en: Books and teaching frame Ban Zhao as a learned woman. This Qing interpretation of a Han historian also reflects Cao Zhenxiu’s interest in women’s varied talents.
interpretation.zh: 书册与教学场景突出班昭的学者身份。清人对汉代史家的描绘，也体现曹贞秀对女性多方面才能的关注。

title.en: Qu Yuan in the Ming encyclopedia Sancai Tuhui
title.zh: 明代《三才图会》中的屈原

alt.en: A line-drawn bearded man with a tied headcloth appears below the inscription naming Qu Yuan of Chu.
alt.zh: 线描蓄须男子束巾，头顶题字“楚屈原像”。

caption.en: Qu Yuan in Sancai Tuhui, compiled by Wang Qi and Wang Siyi in the early seventeenth century and published in 1609. This is a Ming representation of an ancient poet.
caption.zh: 《三才图会》屈原像；该书由王圻、王思义于十七世纪初编纂，1609年刊行。这是明人对古代诗人的表现。

items.creator: Wang Qi and Wang Siyi, compilers; print artist unidentified
items.institution: Sancai Tuhui; digitized reproduction on Wikimedia Commons

interpretation.en: The name above the figure identifies the subject. The printed likeness reveals later commemoration rather than the appearance of a person who lived roughly nineteen centuries earlier.
interpretation.zh: 像上题名标明人物身份。这幅印本呈现后世纪念方式，不是约十九个世纪前古人容貌的证据。

title.en: Du Fu in a Yuan portrait scroll

alt.en: A small robed figure stands beneath dense inscriptions, surrounded by red seals and a wide mounted border.
alt.zh: 宽阔装裱内，一位着袍人物站在密集题跋下方，周围钤有红印。

caption.en: Portrait of Du Fu, catalogued by the Palace Museum as a Yuan work by Zhao Mengfu. The hanging scroll combines the poet’s figure with later inscriptions and collecting marks.
caption.zh: 故宫博物院著录为元代赵孟頫作《杜甫像轴》。立轴将诗人形象与后世题跋、鉴藏印结合在一起。

items.creator: Zhao Mengfu (1254–1322), per Palace Museum catalogue
items.date: Yuan dynasty; later inscriptions and mounting

interpretation.en: The comparatively small figure is enveloped by writing and seals. The scroll records Du Fu’s reception centuries after his life, rather than witnessing a Tang event.
interpretation.zh: 相对小幅的人像被文字与印章环绕。画卷记录杜甫身后数百年的接受史，而不是唐代事件的现场见证。

title.en: Mencius in a Yuan album of Confucian sages

alt.en: A bearded man in pale robes and a dark-trimmed collar faces right; a vertical label names Meng Ke.
alt.zh: 蓄须男子穿浅色袍服、领缘为深色，面朝右侧；竖题标明孟轲。

caption.en: Mencius in Half Portraits of the Great Sage and Virtuous Men of Old, an anonymous Yuan album made after the 1330 conferral of titles. National Palace Museum, Taipei.
caption.zh: 无款元代《至圣先贤半身像》中的孟子，册中题衔显示绘于1330年加封之后，台北国立故宫博物院藏。

items.creator: Anonymous Yuan painter
items.institution: National Palace Museum, Taipei, 中畫000329 (album)

interpretation.en: The formal label places Mencius in a lineage of honored Confucian teachers. It documents a Yuan image of authority, not a contemporary Warring States portrait.
interpretation.zh: 正式题衔把孟子列入受尊崇的儒家师承序列。它呈现元代的权威形象，不是战国时期的当世肖像。

title.en: Bai Juyi’s Pipa Song in Wen Zhengming’s calligraphy
title.zh: 文徵明书白居易《琵琶行》

alt.en: Slanting rows of running-script characters and red seals fill a silk handscroll displayed behind glass.
alt.zh: 展柜中的绢本手卷写有行书，行列略带斜势，末尾有红印。

caption.en: A Ming transcription of Bai Juyi’s Pipa Song by Wen Zhengming, photographed in the Treasures of Ancient China exhibition on 25 October 2007. Photograph: Editor at Large.
caption.zh: 文徵明书白居易《琵琶行》，明代作品；2007年10月25日摄于“中华瑰宝”展览。摄影：Editor at Large。

items.creator: Wen Zhengming (1470–1559); photograph by Editor at Large
items.institution: Treasures of Ancient China exhibition; permanent collection not identified in source

interpretation.en: The later handscroll shows how Bai Juyi’s poem continued to be performed through brushwork. It is Wen Zhengming’s writing, not Bai Juyi’s autograph or a picture of the poem’s musician.
interpretation.zh: 后世手卷展示白居易诗歌如何继续通过笔墨获得表现。这是文徵明的书迹，不是白居易手稿，也不是诗中乐人的图像。

title.en: Li Qingzhao holding flowers in a Qing painting
title.zh: 清代画作中持花的李清照

alt.en: A woman with pinned-up dark hair holds flowers near her face; long inscriptions descend through the open space above.
alt.zh: 挽黑发的女子持花近面，头顶大片留白间写有长题。

caption.en: Small Portrait of Li Qingzhao by Jiang Xun (1764–1821), Qing dynasty, Wuxi Museum. This retrospective image associates the Song writer with flowers and the passing of spring.
caption.zh: 姜壎（1764—1821）《李清照小像》，清代，无锡博物院藏。这幅后世图像以花与春逝联系宋代词人。

items.creator: Jiang Xun (1764–1821)
items.institution: Wuxi Museum, as identified in the Commons catalogue

interpretation.en: The figure occupies the bottom of a tall sheet, with flowers and abundant empty space above. It is a Qing interpretation of the poet, not a Song-period likeness.
interpretation.zh: 人物位于狭长画幅下方，花枝上方留出大片空白。这是清人对词人的诠释，并非宋代容貌实录。

context.en: A Tang copy of the preface composed for the Orchid Pavilion gathering of 353.
context.zh: 353年兰亭雅集所作序文的唐代摹本。

context.en: The celebrated preface survives through later copies, including this Tang sheet attributed to Feng Chengsu.
context.zh: 著名序文经后世摹本流传，其中包括这件传为冯承素所作的唐摹本。

context.en: Chen Hongshou’s Returning Home imagines the poet whose resignation is described here. Its 1650 image belongs to the later reception of that choice.
context.zh: 陈洪绶《归去来》描绘本条辞官的诗人；1650年的画作属于后世对这一选择的理解。

context.en: Qu Yuan, the courtier in this entry, appears as a remembered poet in this Ming encyclopedia.
context.zh: 本条中的朝臣屈原，在这部明代百科图书中被塑造成后人记忆中的诗人。

context.en: The Ming print gives a later face to the poet whose exile and writing anchor this entry.
context.zh: 明代版画为本条放逐与创作故事的主角提供后世诗人形象。

context.en: A Yuan portrait of the author of Spring View, made centuries after the poem’s wartime setting.
context.zh: 《春望》作者的元代肖像，比诗中战乱背景晚数百年。

context.en: Du Fu in a Yuan portrait scroll, accompanying the story of his early Mount Tai poem.
context.zh: 元代立轴中的杜甫，与他早年泰山诗作的故事相联系。

context.en: This Yuan portrait of Du Fu pairs with the Song painting of Li Bai: two later images of poets who travelled together in 744–745.
context.zh: 这幅元代杜甫像与宋代李白图相对照：两位744至745年同游诗人的后世形象。

context.en: The retrospective scroll introduces Du Fu, whose family losses and official disappointments shaped his writing.
context.zh: 后世画卷呈现杜甫；家难与仕途失意塑造了他的写作。

context.en: A later portrait of the poet remembered through the Chengdu cottage and its poems.
context.zh: 后世杜甫像，使成都草堂及诗歌所纪念的诗人可见。

context.en: The Yuan portrait accompanies Du Fu’s Kuizhou years and the poems associated with them.
context.zh: 元代肖像与杜甫夔州时期及相关诗作相联系。

context.en: A commemorative portrait of the poet whose final travels are described here.
context.zh: 这幅纪念性肖像呈现本条晚年行旅中的诗人。

context.en: The Yuan album names Meng Ke, or Mencius, whose dialogue with King Hui contrasts profit and humane rule.
context.zh: 元代册页题名孟轲，即与梁惠王讨论利与仁义的孟子。

context.en: A Yuan image of Mencius as an honored teacher, linked here to his arguments about humane government.
context.zh: 元代孟子尊师形象，与本条讨论仁政的思想相联系。

context.en: The photographed scroll transcribes the Pipa Song named in this entry, showing the Tang poem’s later Ming calligraphic life.
context.zh: 照片中的手卷书写本条《琵琶行》，呈现唐诗在明代书法中的延续。

context.en: Jiang Xun’s later painting identifies Li Qingzhao, the collector and writer named here; flowers express her literary afterlife rather than inventorying the Qingzhou collection.
context.zh: 姜壎后世画作标识本条收藏者、词人李清照；花枝表达其文学接受史，而非罗列青州藏品。

context.en: The Qing painting commemorates Li Qingzhao, the writer named in this Jinhua episode, rather than illustrating a specific visit to Bayong Tower.
context.zh: 清代画作追怀本条金华经历中的李清照，并非描绘某次八咏楼之游。
